items.title: Base makes quantum security a 2027 priority as regulators warn of risks
items.summary: Base creator Jesse Pollak says the upcoming Everest upgrade will help prepare wallets for future quantum threats, although further changes will be needed.

items.title: Citi Says Customers Are Responsible When AI Banking Agents Go Rogue—Even After a Hack
items.summary: Citibank’s updated terms put customers on the hook for outside AI agents, including leaked logins.

items.title: North Korea Moves $247 Million of Binance Hack Loot Through Bitcoin Mixers
items.summary: Roughly a month after the $6.4 billion hack, Elliptic says nearly all of the coinjoin mixing was coordinated by one person who “refuses to block funds such as these."

items.title: US seeks to recover $1.1B in crypto stolen in North Korea-linked Binance hack
items.summary: US prosecutors are seeking control of stolen USDC, while Elliptic says hackers have moved $247 million through Bitcoin mixers.

items.title: Grayscale’s new 2x leveraged Zcash ETF takes 13% opening day tumble
items.summary: Grayscale’s ZECX debuted less than three months after its spot Zcash ETF began trading on NYSE Arca.
